_comment: POST /api/v1/supervisor/sessions/{sessionId}/whisper — the supervisor's text whisper (change supervisor-whisper-reaches-the-agent). {sessionId} is the Agent Assist session id the monitor lists (ActiveSessionDto.sessionId). Server record: WhisperRequest(string Text), SupervisorEndpoints.cs:638 (on Platform main 83e434c2).

fields.text: string; required; trimmed; empty or above the length bound the host design fixes -> 400

responses.204: No Content, no body: the whisper was published to the session's agent as agentassist.suggestion (Source "Supervisor", Priority "Critical"); see agentassist-events.v1.json for the event shape. Owner answer 2026-11-21 (option A): 204, not an empty 200, because the console's customFetch skips the body only on 204 (Web client.ts:405) and rejects an empty 200 (Web use-auth-admin.test.tsx:372-382, the auth route that moved to 204)
responses.404: no live Agent Assist session of the caller's tenant with that id
responses.409: the session's agent or conversation is not resolved yet; nothing was published

event.agentId: the session's bound agent (AgentAssistSessionIdentity), never taken from the request
event.suggestionId: a new id per whisper (host spec R2); the console keys the banner item, its timer and its dismiss on it (Web use-sse.ts suggestionOf: id = data.suggestionId, since Web #524)
event.sessionId: the Agent Assist session id of the route; present, ignored by the console

refusalBodies._note: 404 has no body; a malformed JSON body gets the framework's 400. The console chooses its message by status only (Web design D2).
